units.source_text: "你为什么要来和我搭话，我全明白了。

en.t: I understand perfectly why you came over to speak to me.
Your surname is Mizoguchi, isn't it?

units.source_text: 残疾人之间可以交个朋友嘛。

en.t: People with disabilities can make friends with each other, after all.

units.source_text: 不过，比起我来，你把自己的口吃看得太严重了吧？

en.t: But compared with me, aren't you taking your own stutter far too seriously?
You place too much importance on yourself,

units.source_text: 所以和自己一起过分地重视自己的口吃吧。"

en.t: and so along with yourself, you place too much importance on your stutter as well."
